purpose.zh: 练肩膀往上推的劲，给倒立打底子
purpose.en: Builds pushing strength in your shoulders as a step toward handstands.

text.zh: 屁股一直顶高，弯手肘让头落到两手前面
text.en: Hips stay high, bend your elbows and lower your head in front of your hands

text.zh: 身子成倒 V 字，两手跟肩膀一样宽，腿伸直。
text.en: Upside-down V, hands shoulder-width, legs straight.

text.zh: 手肘斜着往后弯，再撑回手臂伸直。
text.en: Elbows bend back at an angle, then push back to straight arms.

commonErrors.en: Elbows flaring and head shooting forward.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股掉下来，成了普通俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Hips dropping into a regular push-up.

cautions.zh: 头朝下压在手腕上，先转转手腕；刺疼就停
cautions.en: Your weight is over your wrists, so warm them up. Stop on sharp pain.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼就下浅点；做不满就把手撑在凳子上做
cautions.en: If your shoulders hurt, don't go as low. Can't get them all? Put your hands on a stool.
